name: rebuy-de__ds-pub-utils
behavioral_change: pandas v_old 0.20.3 to v_new 2.3.1 (resolved value; ruled the responsible library). The result of pandas.Series.value_counts (value_counts_internal) no longer preserves the Series name and index name; the case is mixed with the interface-level removal of OneHotEncoder n_values in scikit-learn 0.19.1 to 1.7.1.
downstream_effect: The downstream computations that rely on the preserved name and index name fail their tests after the upgrade; the case carries a human test_patch.
reference_fix: The reference fix adapts the downstream code to the changed name and index-name semantics of the pandas result and to the renamed scikit-learn interface.

upgrade.note: TimeMachine-bench case: every dependency is resolved at the dated snapshot; the library at v_old/v_new is the one whose behavioral change breaks the tests.
